'''Fostin Nine''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==History==
During the [[Republic Dark Age]], the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Beld Yulan]] lost his children to a plague on the moon, which caused him to be overcome by depression and later join an [[Odionate|Odionite]] death cult.

A millennia later, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] ordered [[Omega Squad]] to perform a reconnaissance there.<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
